newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bankruptcies down 41 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Danish bankruptcies down 41 pct year-on-year.

text.p: The number of Danish firms declaring bankruptcy fell to 126 in November, down from 164 in October 1996 and 212 in November 1995, the National Statistics Office said on Monday.
But a three-month seasonally-corrected sliding index showed a one percent rise in failures between September and November 1996, the office added.
Worst-hit were hotels and restaurants in the Copenhagen region, a breakdown of the figures showed. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
